intro_text: Our Commitment to Healthcare: Bringing accessible medical screening, chronic disease management, and hospital referrals closer to underserved communities in Cambodia.
area1_description: Conducted mass health clinics across Kbal Koh, Tum Nub Kor Phram, and Mother of Peace Kindergarten. Screened 1,068 villagers for acute illnesses, chronic hypertension, diabetes, skin infections, and hair lice.
area2_description: Ensuring care extends beyond screening sites by connecting villagers with chronic conditions to local healthcare institutions, providing follow-up assessments and subsidized medication.
area3_description: Engaging Cambodian counterparts, local hospitals, and pharmacies during recce trips to establish sustainable, locally grounded healthcare partnerships.
